turns.user: I validated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00.
turns.agent:
If you’re asking about timing: the 30-minute window runs from 10:00 to 10:30. Transfers on covered lines are allowed within that window. If your final transfer happens before 10:30, you may complete that last ride after 10:30; the window is not necessarily a deadline to get off the vehicle. Validate at the start and when changing lines, except between metro lines. The 30-minute mobile ticket requires an internet-connected phone and has no paper equivalent.

These details are from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not live verification. See BKK’s 30-minute ticket rules for current conditions. What route or transfer are you considering?

turns.user: Can I transfer to another tram at 10:31 using that same ticket?
turns.agent: No—not for a new tram transfer at 10:31. Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, transfers on covered lines must be made within the 30-minute window, so a transfer at 10:31 is outside the window that began at 10:00. The allowance to continue past 10:30 applies only when your final transfer was made before the window ended; it doesn’t extend the time to board another line. BKK: 30-minute ticket. This is snapshot-based guidance, not live verification.
